name: meeting-ai-app
description: AI 회의 보조 데스크톱 앱 - FastAPI(backend) + Node WebSocket(realtime-server) + React/Electron(frontend) 통합본

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix realtime-server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.typecheck:frontend: npm --prefix frontend exec -- tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --incremental false
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
